message.reasoning:
The user wants to check different options for booking flight #1234. They want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024 (i.e., 2024-10-31), business class. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date="2024-10-31", travel_class="business". That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? The user says "I need to arrange a flight as soon as possible on booking number 1234, and want to check different options." So maybe they want to see cost before booking. We can just compute cost. But do we need to actually book? The user didn't explicitly ask to book; they said "arrange a flight" but also "check different options". They want to know estimated total payable amount. So we can compute cost and then add some typical fees? Maybe we can just give the cost returned by get_flight_cost. Or we might need to consider taxes, etc. But the function get_flight_cost returns cost in USD. That likely includes taxes. So we can present that as estimated total payable amount.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then call get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
